integrationSetup.title: Connect Telegram in three steps
integrationSetup.description: Get work reminders in Telegram and choose how often they arrive.
integrationSetup.link: Get a connection code below, open the bot and press Start. Keep this page open: it confirms the connection automatically.
integrationSetup.preferences: Open Notification preferences to choose alerts, summaries and quiet hours. Linking alone does not change those preferences.
integrationSetup.commands: Send /help in the bot for commands, or /app to open your workspace inside Telegram.
integrationSetup.group: For a department group: add the bot to your group, get a group connection code below, then paste the full /connect command into the group.
integrationSetup.telegramUnavailable: The bot cannot be reached right now. Your inbox still works. Try again shortly or contact your administrator.
